training.claim: single-seed compatibility and bounded recorded-input imitation evaluation only
training.held_out: evaluate once after both dev-selected checkpoints are written; no tuning or selection
training.hidden_state: zero at episode start; carry forward and detach only at training window boundaries
training.natural_endings: retain goal/stall/contact/time termination; no padding, reset, replacement, or held-out-driven collection
training.order: frozen CLI run order, increasing episodes/ticks; identical across both variants
training.recurrent_weights: fixed positive connection counts; shared 0.9/original_max_incoming_weight scale for both topologies
training.selection: minimum dev loss across five epochs; first epoch wins exact ties
